# Task (`task`)

What the robot is asked to do.

Groups are in bold; leaves (ODD parameters) are in code font with type, unit, physical bounds and nominal distribution.

- `goal_distance` (continuous; m; [0, 1000]): Straight-line distance from start to goal. Aliases: route length, travel distance, distance to goal.
- `target_object` (categorical; values: mug, bowl, bottle, box, book, tool): The object the robot has to find or manipulate. Aliases: target, object to pick, item.
